India mein ₹3,000 ke budget ke andar kai acche aur trusted brands ke running shoes mil jaate hain jo daily running, walking, aur gym ke liye best hain.

The adidas Men Galaxy 7 Running Shoes features a **Cloudfoam midsole** for maximum cushioning and a **breathable upper**.

The Puma Skyrocket Lite Men Unisex Running Shoes uses **Puma Lite foam** and **Protread rubber** for durability and great traction on the road.

The ASICS Men JOLT 4 Running Shoes combines an **EVA midsole** and a **soft OrthoLite sockliner** for all-day comfortable walking and running.

The Decathlon Kiprun Men Jogflow 190.1 Superior Grip Cushioned Running Shoes For Men offers **exceptional cushioning** and **breathable mesh panels** built for weekly training sessions up to 20 kilometers.

The Women's adidas Runfalcon 5 Running Shoes comes with a **cushy Cloudfoam midsole** and a **durable Adiwear outsole** for reliable everyday training.

The Women's adidas Response Running Shoes provides a **supportive fit** and dependable build quality for daily fitness routines.
